name: Bonscape
tagline: Bonscape is visual canvas for interacting with AI chats, designed for visual thinkers
description: Bonscape is visual canvas for interacting with AI chats, designed for visual thinkers. It allows users to brainstorm naturally by creating a branching conversation flow on an infinite canvas. Users can seamlessly switch between them without losing context. The platform supports side-by-side comparison of outputs from different AI models, enabling users to identify the most effective and cost-efficient AI for specific tasks. Key features include a visual branching canvas, model-agnostic support,
